title: Benowitz's APRO membership application

tellings.quote: they said, "What's your favorite UFO book?" And he said, "Books by Heinick." That's all he said.

plain: Sometime between 1977 and 1979, a man named Paul Bennewitz applied to join the Aerial Phenomena Research Organization, or APRO, a civilian UFO research group based in Arizona. Greg Bishop, who has looked into Bennewitz's life and says he has seen the form, says one question asked for his favorite UFO book, and that Bennewitz wrote only "Books by Hynek," meaning the UFO researcher J. Allen Hynek. Bishop tells it to show where Bennewitz's interest in the subject stood before his later troubles.
